data: Amazon delivered a decisive profitability turnaround in fiscal 2023. Revenue rose to $574.8 billion from $514.0 billion in fiscal 2022, representing growth of 11.8%. Gross profit expanded faster, reaching $270.0 billion in fiscal 2023 against $225.2 billion in fiscal 2022, for a fiscal 2023 gross margin of 47.0%. The more striking improvement came further down the income statement. Operating income climbed to $36.9 billion in fiscal 2023 from $12.2 billion in fiscal 2022, lifting the fiscal 2023 operating margin to 6.4%. Net income swung to $30.4 billion in fiscal 2023 from a loss of $2.7 billion in fiscal 2022, and diluted EPS moved to $2.90 from a loss of $0.27 per share. We view fiscal 2023 as evidence that Amazon's cost discipline is translating top-line growth into meaningful earnings leverage.
